question: How do I create a kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To create a kMeet meeting: 1) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or from the desktop/mobile app. 2) Start a new meeting. 3) Enter a name for your meeting room. 4) Allow access to webcam and microphone. 5) Enter your name or pseudonym. 6) Optionally enable participant control, password, or encryption. 7) Click 'Join the meeting'. 8) Share the room link to invite participants.
actual_response:
To create a **kMeet meeting**, follow these steps:

### **Basic Steps**
1. **Access kMeet**:
   - Open [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) in your browser or use the kMeet app on your device (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android).
2. **Start a New Meeting**:
   - Click "Start a new meeting" or similar option.  
   *(Source: [Create a kMeet meeting](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2475))*  

---

### **Advanced Options**
- **Secure the Meeting**:
  - Set a **password** and **encryption key** during setup to protect the room.  
  *(Source: [Secure a kMeet meeting](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2464))*  
- **Integrate with Calendar**:
  - Create the meeting via the [Infomaniak calendar](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/956) and add the kMeet link to the event.  
  *(Source: [Manage kMeet participants](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2476))*  

---

### **Additional Notes**
- **kChat Integration**:  
  - Meetings initiated from kChat will sync with your chat thread, showing status updates and messages.  
  *(Source: [Create a kMeet meeting from kChat](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2827))*  

For full details, refer to the [Getting Started Guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2474).

question: What should I do if my audio is not working in kMeet?
ground_truth: To fix audio issues in kMeet: 1) Go to kMeet Settings and reauthorize microphone access. 2) Check browser lock icon isn't blocking multimedia. 3) On mobile, check Settings > Privacy > Microphone permissions for kMeet. 4) On Windows, use Privacy settings and Audio Troubleshooter. 5) Try joining from a different device (mobile instead of computer or vice versa). 6) As last resort on Firefox, disable WebRTC in about:config by setting media.peerconnection.enabled to false.
actual_response:

1. Open **Windows Settings** > **Privacy**.

question: How do I create side rooms (breakout rooms) in kMeet?
ground_truth: To create side rooms in kMeet: 1) You must be a moderator. 2) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or app. 3) Once participants are in the meeting, click on the multi-user icon in the toolbar. 4) Click the button to add a side room. 5) Participants can then join or leave the room. 6) The moderator can force participants to join a specific side room via the action menu. Side rooms allow dividing a main meeting into several simultaneous discussions in distinct virtual spaces.

actual_response:

question: How can I record a kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To record a kMeet meeting: Prerequisites: Have a kDrive, be the moderator, and don't use encrypted meeting with custom key. Steps: 1) Start kMeet. 2) Once in the meeting, click on the action menu (three dots). 3) Click 'Start recording'. 4) Log in to Infomaniak if needed and select a kDrive for storage. 5) To stop, click the toolbar again and choose 'Stop recording'. 6) The recording is saved to the kDrive root in .mp4 format when all participants leave. Maximum duration is 3 hours.
actual_response:
To record a **kMeet meeting** on **kDrive**, follow these steps:

### 🎬 Record a kMeet Meeting on kDrive
1. **Start kMeet** via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or your device app.
2. **Join a meeting** or create a new one.
3. Click the **action menu** (○○○) in the kMeet toolbar.
4. Select the **record icon** (◉) to start recording.
5. **Confirm the action**:
   - Log in to your Infomaniak account if prompted.
   - Choose a **kDrive folder** to save the recording.
6. Click **Start** to begin recording.

### 📌 Prerequisites
- You must be the **moderator** of the meeting.
- Ensure the meeting is **not encrypted** (custom key encryption is incompatible with recording).
- Recordings are saved in **.mp4 format** on kDrive (max 3 hours).

### ⚠️ Notes
- Recordings are stored **server-side** (no load on participants' devices).
- For encrypted meetings, recording is **not supported**.

Source: [Infomaniak Support FAQ](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2472/save-a-kmeet-meeting-on-kdrive)

question: How do I set a password for my kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To protect a kMeet meeting with a password: 1) Start kMeet via kmeet.infomaniak.com or app. 2) Start a new meeting. 3) Enter the meeting room name. 4) Click on 'security options'. 5) Enable the toggle switch to 'Protect access'. 6) Create the password. 7) Click Continue to start. 8) Share both the meeting link/code AND the password with participants. You can also enable end-to-end encryption from security options (works only with Chromium-based browsers).
actual_response:
To set a password for your kMeet meeting, follow these steps:

1. **Start kMeet** via [kmeet.infomaniak.com](https://kmeet.infomaniak.com) or your device app.
2. **Create a new meeting**:
   - Enter a name for your meeting room.
   - Click **Security options**.
   - Enable **Protect access** by toggling the switch.
   - Set your desired **password**.
   - Click **Continue** to start the meeting.
3. **Share details**: Distribute the **meeting link/code** and **password** to participants (you can re-display the password via the "Invite" button).

**Note**: Participants must enter the password when joining the meeting.  
Source: [Secure a kMeet meeting with a password and encryption key](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2464)

question: How can I livestream a kMeet meeting?
ground_truth: To livestream a kMeet meeting: Prerequisites: Must be a moderator (no Video Streaming offer required). Steps: 1) Start kMeet via ksuite.infomaniak.com/kmeet or app. 2) Once in the meeting, click the action menu (three dots). 3) Choose 'Start live broadcast'. 4) Click 'Start' button. 5) Wait for Video Streaming to be created. 6) Copy the stream URL and share it with viewers. 7) A symbol and audio alert indicate the broadcast start. The stream is continuous for max 24 hours and stops when the kMeet meeting ends.

question: How do I resolve sync conflicts in kDrive?
ground_truth: Sync conflicts occur when: a file is modified locally AND on kDrive Web simultaneously, or during conflicting create/move operations. Resolution: kDrive Web version is kept, local version is saved as '[filename]_conflict'. Options: 1) Keep both (only original syncs). 2) Delete _conflict if it's older. 3) Delete original and rename _conflict to sync it. 4) Manually merge then delete _conflict. To view conflicts: click kDrive icon > info button > view events. From version 3.6.11, locally modified files are moved to 'kDrive Rescue Folder' instead of deleted. Avoid conflicts by not working on the same file with multiple people.
key_points: conflicts when same file modified locally and online
can keep both, delete, or merge
actual_response:
To resolve sync conflicts in kDrive, follow these steps:

- **Prevent conflicts** by:
  - Avoiding simultaneous edits on the same file (unless using collaborative tools like Word/Excel online).
  - Syncing offline changes before making online modifications.
  - Avoiding duplicate folder names across devices.  
  *(Source: [Avoid synchronization conflicts](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2403/resolve-a-kdrive-synchronization-conflict))*

- **Manual resolution** (if automatic fixes fail):
  1. Open the **conflict resolution tab** in the kDrive app (indicated by an orange icon).
  2. Choose to **send the local version to the server** (synchronize) or **move it to the recycle bin** (discard).  
  *(Source: [Resolve a kDrive synchronization conflict](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2403/resolve-a-kdrive-synchronization-conflict))*

- **Automatic conflict rules**:
  - kDrive prioritizes the most recent version (server or local) based on timestamps.  
  *(Source: [Managing synchronization conflicts](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2403/resolve-a-kdrive-synchronization-conflict))*

For advanced cases, check the [kDrive conflict cases guide](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2403/resolve-a-kdrive-synchronization-conflict).

question: How do I manage user rights in kDrive?
ground_truth: kDrive has 2 permission levels: 1) Administrator - same rights as owner (sharing, statistics, restore/delete folders, import data, access all files). 2) User - access folders at root, create/share content, but cannot manage product, view statistics, or create root folders. To modify: 1) Go to ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive. 2) Click action menu next to the kDrive. 3) Click 'Manage users'. 4) Select user and choose access level. Note: Don't confuse Manager rights (product management) with kDrive rights (data access). A user can have restricted Manager rights but be Administrator in kDrive.
key_points: don't confuse Manager rights with kDrive rights
actual_response:
To manage user rights in **kDrive**, follow these steps:

### Steps to Modify User Permissions:
1. **Access kDrive Web App**  
   Go to [https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive](https://ksuite.infomaniak.com/kdrive) (source: [FAQ 2365](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2365/manage-a-kdrive-users-rights)).

2. **Select the Relevant kDrive**  
   Use the dropdown menu in the left sidebar to choose the specific kDrive instance.

3. **Open User Management**  
   Click the **action menu ⋮** next to the selected kDrive, then choose **"Manage users"**.

4. **Adjust Permissions**  
   - **Technical Rights**: Allow access to files/folders but hide statistics.  
   - **Statistics Rights**: Enable access to analytics/dashboard but restrict file management.  
   (Source: [FAQ 2365](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2365/manage-a-kdrive-users-rights))

### Key Notes:
- Users can have **restricted rights** (no management access) or be **administrators** with full access.  
- Rights are managed per kDrive instance.  
- For organizational-level permissions, refer to [FAQ 1633](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1633/manage-a-users-rights-within-an-organization).  

For further details, consult the full guides linked above.

question: How do I sync kDrive with my Synology NAS?
ground_truth: To sync kDrive with Synology NAS via WebDAV: Prerequisites: Synology NAS accessible from Internet, know your kDrive ID. Steps: 1) Log in to Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM). 2) Install Cloud Sync from Package Center if needed. 3) Open Cloud Sync. 4) Click + to add a Cloud. 5) Choose WebDAV. 6) Enter: Server address: https://[kDriveID].connect.kdrive.infomaniak.com, Username: Infomaniak email, Password: create an application password. 7) Select local folder, destination, and sync type: Bidirectional (changes in both directions), Download remote only (backup kDrive to NAS), or Download local only (backup NAS to kDrive).

actual_response:

- **Install Synology Drive App**: Ensure the Synology Drive app is installed on your NAS device. This app facilitates cloud storage integration. [Synology Drive Documentation](https://www.synology.com/en-us/dsm/DSM-Drive)
- **Configure Sync Folder**: Set up the folder on your NAS that you want to sync with kDrive. This is done via the Synology Drive app settings. [Synology Drive Setup Guide](https://www.synology.com/en-us/knowledgebase/article/100087)

question: How can I invite external users to kChat?

  2. Invite the external user via email.
  3. They will create an Infomaniak account if they don’t already have one.
  4. They gain access to kChat but are **not counted** as a kSuite user or part of your Organization.
- **Source**: [Invite an external user to use kChat](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2846/invite-an-external-user-to-use-kchat)

---

### **Method 2: Invite as a kSuite User (Counted Toward License)**
- **Prerequisites**: The user will become part of your Organization and be counted as a kSuite user.
- **Steps**:
  1. Go to your Organization’s settings in kChat.
  2. Invite the user via email and select "Add to Organization."
  3. They will be granted access to kChat and other kSuite tools.
  4. They are **counted** toward your kSuite license.
- **Source**: [Invite a user to use kChat](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/1455/invite-a-user-to-use-kchat)

---

### **Additional Notes**
- For channel-specific access (without Organization membership), refer to the [guide on granting access to kChat channels](https://www.infomaniak.com/en/support/faq/2846/invite-an-external-user-to-use-kchat).
- If the user is part of a work team, you can invite the entire team via kChat’s settings.
